text.tspan: MONDAY MAYHEM
@unhappychoice detonates 87 commits in a single day. Dependabot trembles.
WORDS MATTER
@unhappychoice publishes 151-line manifesto on who counts as an engineer
RUBBER STAMP
@unhappychoice approves 62 PRs in one week. Wrist reportedly still attached.
ROBOT ALLY
@unhappychoice lets LiteLLM pipeline sync pricing twice. Trusts the machine.
MULTILINGUAL
@unhappychoice wrangles Ruby, Rust, Java, and JS deps in a single week. Unhinged.
NET NEGATIVE
@unhappychoice merges dep bump that deletes 213 lines. Somehow a win.
FLEET ADMIRAL
@unhappychoice patrols 8 repos in 7 days. No dependency left behind.
STEADY HANDS
@unhappychoice posts 40-53 commits daily for 5 straight days. Metronome energy.
